$comment: The rule table of the module-boundary gate.
Source of truth: ARCHITECTURE.md §2 (the layers), docs/adr/ADR-0001
The boundary is data, not code: the gate reads this table and knows
nothing about the layers of the shell itself.
sources  - the files the rule applies to. A glob with '*' (one path
segment) and '**' (any number of segments), relative to the
targets  - the modules the sources must not import. A target matches
the module itself and everything below it.
A module that re-exports a target is a target as well -
the gate computes that closure itself, so a proxy barrel
cannot be used to smuggle the catalogue into a component.
Change this file only together with an ADR.

rules.description: No component and no page may import the raw song catalogue.
rules.reason: The raw catalogue carries the answers of the round (hints, lyrics) and the whole catalogue at once. A component that imports it pulls the answer key into the browser bundle (QA-SPO-001) and couples the presentation to the storage format of the catalogue (QA-ARC-006).
rules.remediation: Import the narrow interface of the catalogue instead: `import { loadCatalogue, loadPack } from '@/data/catalogue'`.

rules.description: The configuration must not import from the components.
rules.reason: The configuration is the leaf of the shell: it holds the constants of the game and must be readable without any part of the user interface. An import of a component inverts the dependency direction of ADR-0001 and makes the constants untestable without a DOM.
rules.remediation: Move the value into `src/config/` or into `src/types/`, or read it from the store at the call site.

rules.description: The pure helpers must not import from the store.
rules.reason: The helpers of `src/utils/` are pure functions without a state. An import of the store makes them depend on the session and therefore untestable in isolation - the reason why the helpers of this directory have their own unit tests.
rules.remediation: Pass the state as an argument, or move the function into `src/stores/` where the state belongs.
